title: Two North Block Captains needed for Thatcher Palm E
summary: A Block Captain is needed to deliver the Link booklets door to door to 13-29, 26-48 Thatch East year round. A Block Captain is needed to deliver the Link booklets door to door to 37-51, 46-60 Thatch East from May to December. The deliveries have already been made this month. The next delivery will start the end of July.
